name: edit_theme
description: Update the name, tags, or visibility of a theme YOU published to 21st.dev. Owner-only - the id must belong to the signed-in caller (404 otherwise). Provide at least one field. `tags`, when provided, REPLACES the full tag set. Themes only support public|private visibility (no 'unlisted').

tags.description: Tag slugs - REPLACES the full tag set.
